titulo: Anthony Scaramucci on the White House firing that forced him to rethink failure, ego and his career
cuerpo: SkyBridge Capital founder Anthony Scaramucci reflects on the decision to face his public downfall after being fired from the Trump White House after 11 days. He discusses pride, ego, failure, rebuilding his career and why he believes the only way through a mistake is to own it and face it head-on.
